$comment: Reviewed registry for lint-property-names.cjs. Synonym groups say which spelling of a concept is canonical; exemptions are permanent and carry a reason each. Word lists only tune the plural heuristics. Existing violations are not listed here: they live in lint-property-names-baseline.json, which is empty at 4.0.0.

synonyms.concept: the instant an object was created
the instant an object last changed
the instant after which an object no longer applies
the number of results across all pages
the number of governance checks performed
the street line of a postal address
the maximum number of characters in a text value

tokenSynonyms.concept: lower bound; `min` is used 120 times and `minimum` 14
upper bound; `max` is used 224 times and `maximum` 5
a configured share, as docs/spec-guidelines.md names it
origin of a value; `source` is used 97 times and `src` once

exemptions.rationale: These schemas mirror the external A2UI component specification. Its property names and types are A2UI's, not AdCP's.
`$schema` is the JSON Schema convention for a document that names its own schema (adagents.json, brand.json, trust.json).
This meta-schema describes extension schema files, so its property names are JSON Schema keywords such as `$id` and `additionalProperties`.
The leading underscore marks a control key that can't collide with the payload field it replaces.
